pairs: And the Lord said to Samuel:
“How long will you mourn for Saul,
cum ego projecerim eum ne regnet super Israël?
so that he would not reign over Israel?
Fill your horn with oil and approach,
ut mittam te ad Isai Bethlehemitem:
so that I may send you to Jesse of Bethlehem.
providi enim in filiis ejus mihi regem.
For I have provided a king from among his sons for myself.”
For Saul will hear of it,
and he will put me to death.”
Vitulum de armento tolles in manu tua,
“You shall take, by your hand, a calf from the herd.
‘I have arrived in order to immolate to the Lord.’
And you shall call Jesse to the sacrifice,
et ego ostendam tibi quid facias,
and I will reveal to you what you should do.
And you shall anoint whomever I will indicate to you.”
Fecit ergo Samuel sicut locutus est ei Dominus.
Therefore, Samuel did just as the Lord told him.
et admirati sunt seniores civitatis occurrentes ei:
and the elders of the city wondered. And meeting him,
I have arrived in order to immolate to the Lord.
and come with me to the sacrifice.”
Sanctificavit ergo Isai et filios ejus,
Then he sanctified Jesse and his sons,
and he called them to the sacrifice.
Num coram Domino est christus ejus?
“Could he be the Christ in the sight of the Lord?”
And the Lord said to Samuel:
“You should not look with favor on his face,
nor on the height of his stature.
nec juxta intuitum hominis ego judico:
Neither do I judge by the appearance of a man.
homo enim videt ea quæ parent,
For man sees those things that are apparent,
but the Lord beholds the heart.”
and he brought him before Samuel.
“Neither has the Lord chosen this one.”
“And the Lord has not chosen this one.”
Adduxit itaque Isai septem filios suos coram Samuele:
And so Jesse brought his seven sons before Samuel.
“The Lord has not chosen any of these.”
For we shall not recline to eat,
nec enim discumbemus priusquam huc ille veniat.
Therefore, Samuel took the horn of oil,
et unxit eum in medio fratrum ejus:
and he anointed him in the midst of his brothers.
et directus est spiritus Domini a die illa in David, et deinceps.
And the Spirit of the Lord was guiding David from that day and thereafter.
And Samuel rose up, and he went away to Ramah.
Spiritus autem Domini recessit a Saul,
But the Spirit of the Lord withdrew from Saul,
et exagitabat eum spiritus nequam a Domino.
and a wicked spirit from the Lord disturbed him.
And the servants of Saul said to him:
Ecce spiritus Dei malus exagitat te.
“Behold, an evil spirit from God disturbs you.
et servi tui qui coram te sunt quærent hominem scientem psallere cithara,
and your servants, who are before you, will seek a man skillful in playing a stringed instrument,
ut quando arripuerit te spiritus Domini malus,
so that when the evil spirit from the Lord assails you,
he may play with his hand,
and you may bear it more easily.”
Et ait Saul ad servos suos:
And Saul said to his servants,
Providete ergo mihi aliquem bene psallentem,
“Then provide for me someone who can play well,
And one of the servants, responding,
Ecce vidi filium Isai Bethlehemitem scientem psallere,
“Behold, I have seen the son of Jesse of Bethlehem, a skillful player,
And the Lord is with him.”
Misit ergo Saul nuntios ad Isai,
Therefore, Saul sent messengers to Jesse,
Mitte ad me David filium tuum,
Tulit itaque Isai asinum plenum panibus,
And so, Jesse took a donkey laden with bread,
and a kid from one of the goats,
et misit per manum David filii sui Sauli.
and he sent them, by the hand of his son David, to Saul.
and he made him his armor bearer.
invenit enim gratiam in oculis meis.
For he has found favor in my eyes.”
Igitur quandocumque spiritus Domini malus arripiebat Saul,
whenever the evil spirit from the Lord assailed Saul,
David took up his stringed instrument,
and he struck it with his hand,
and Saul was refreshed and uplifted.
recedebat enim ab eo spiritus malus.
For the evil spirit withdrew from him.
